title: Baseline Requirement
description: Machine-readable requirement record traced back to the frozen Architecture Baseline V1 specification (baseline section 293). IDs must never be reused for unrelated requirements (baseline section 293).

evidenceRef.description: Either a bare repo-relative path (legacy shape, no outcome claim beyond 'this artifact exists') or a structured ref carrying a known PASS/CLEAN/SUCCESS-or-otherwise outcome (36th independent review round, finding 5, 'require outcome evidence, not simple path existence' — see runtime/requirements-traceability/traceability.ts's isVerifiedEvidenceRef()).

verificationSource.description: Independent Codex review, 'require outcome-backed evidence references': names WHO/WHAT produced this outcome claim. Required by runtime/requirements-traceability/traceability.ts's isOutcomeVerifiedEvidenceRef() for any outcome-bearing type to satisfy UNIT_TESTED+/PROOF_VERIFIED+ claims.

id.description: Stable requirement ID, e.g. UASF-REQ-0001. Never reused.

source_baseline.description: Baseline document and section this requirement traces to, e.g. 'BASELINE-V1 section 80'.

status.description: Per baseline section 294. No unsupported upgrades: status changes must be backed by actual commits/tests/proofs referenced in the *_refs fields.
